name: LDAP Studio
description: Browse, search, and manage LDAP directories: RFC 4515 filters, directory tree, schema inspection, guarded entry editing, and LDIF/CSV export.
releaseNotes: 代码审查修复版：modifyDn newRDN/newSuperior 控制字符防护并同步 MCP 预检；搜索聚合 10 万防御上限与 MCP digest sizeLimit clamp；tls-insecure 审计回归 ok/denied/error 三值契约；语义色改用主题令牌；Disconnect/WithConn 竞态身份双检防 fd 泄漏等 9 项修复。
